text.p: Swissair AG said 1996 is a year of transition, but its expects to report a profit for the full year.
"The Swissair group expects to post a profit for 1996 as a whole," Swissair said in its six-month statement.
It added that some of the action it has taken to improve its profitability in the medium-term was generating extra costs in the initial stages, while the benefits may take longer to have an impact.
"Nevertheless, developments in the first half of 1996 confirmed the rightness of the general thrust adopted by the group," Swissair said, adding"
"The improvements in the results of the group members companies show signs of continuing in the second half-year."
Swissair reported a 1995 net loss of 147 million Swiss francs, mainly due to restructuring costs of 340 million.
